 The Marvel Cinematic Universe is getting ready for its biggest installment in the entire Multiverse Saga.

 Phase 6 is nearing its end, as the MCU timeline just finished Disney+'s VisionQuest TV show, with the focus now shifting back to Earth's Mightiest Heroes this fall with Avengers: Doomsday . However, as the team-up entry gets closer to its release, Marvel Studios is already starting to work on the follow-up.
 In a new interview with Empire Magazine , Marvel Studios boss Kevin Feige stated that the upcoming Avengers: Secret Wars movie will represent an entirely different genre of story. “[Avengers: Secret Wars] is a whole other genre of story," according to Feige, while Joe Russo agrees with the executive, adding that it is “a really unique world. It’s a really unique story. The only reason to get out of bed every day is to take risks and surprise people and try things that have never been tried before. I think Secret Wars is one of those movies where I hope people will walk out of it and go, ‘I’ve never seen anything like that in my life!’” 
 While principal photography has not started yet on the Phase 6 finale, the Avengers: Secret Wars cast has a number of actors confirmed for the 2027 sequel. Robert Downey Jr., who is returning to the franchise, this time playing Doctor Doom, will suit up once more for the highly anticipated follow-up. With Chris Evans reprising his role as Steve Rogers in Doomsday, the former Captain America has confirmed that he is coming back for the Russo brothers' film next year.
 Letitia Wright confirmed to ScreenRant's Liam Crowley that her Black Panther will be part of Avengers: Secret Wars . Other heroes who will be featured include Simu Liu as Shang-Chi, along with Vanessa Kirby as Sue Storm, Pedro Pascal as Reed Richards, Joseph Quinn and Johnny Storm, and Ebon Moss-Bachrach as Ben Grimm. Florence Pugh also revealed earlier this fall that the new Black Widow, Yelena Belova, is returning, too, in the upcoming MCU movie .
 However, the audience can also expect to see some new faces in the final Multiverse Saga film, as Noah Jupe has been cast in a mystery role. While Deadline reported in 2025 that Sadie Sink, who made her debut this year as Jean Grey in Spider-Man: Brand New Day , will be reprising her role in the 2027 project, Marvel Studios and Disney have yet to confirm her involvement. Given that the X-Men reboot will be the first film to come out after Secret Wars , it would make sense for the Stranger Things veteran to be part of next year's ensemble feature.
 While many have speculated that the Russo brothers' upcoming story will reboot the franchise, that is not what Feige has in mind. Back in July 2025, the Marvel Studios president confirmed that Avengers: Secret Wars will reset the MCU , as he stated the following at the time:
 Kevin Feige: Reboot is a scary word. Reboot can mean a lot of things to a lot of people. Reset, singular timeline — we’re thinking along those lines. X-Men is where that will happen next. They have been a place to tell stories about young people who feel different and who feel Other and who feel like they don’t belong. That’s the universal story of mutants, and that is where we’re going.
 Avengers: Secret Wars opens in theaters on December 17, 2027.
